attempts.summary: Configured secure automatic synchronization of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 to node2. Changes propagate immediately through a path watcher with a persistent five-minute timer fallback. Verified propagation in 5–6 seconds, including after sequential reboots of both nodes. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were preserved.
